  {"id": 17, "label": "unplugged", "description": "This means being off the feeds and apps by choice, missing every meme and trend, talking plainly, and getting news from people and newspapers rather than screens."},
  {"id": 18, "label": "laid-back", "description": "This means being easy and unhurried in any conversation, voice level and stakes low, letting a topic drop without fuss, and never making a moment feel bigger than it is."},
  {"id": 19, "label": "steady", "description": "This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve."},
  {"id": 20, "label": "socially-obtuse", "description": "This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told."}
 ]}
